import json
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path('<ARTIFACTS>/native-replan-v2-reviewed/transfer')

def sha(name):
    return hashlib.sha256((OUT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def write_new(name, value):
    path = OUT / name
    if path.exists():
        raise SystemExit('ORIGINAL_EXISTS_USE_NEW_NAME: ' + name)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

assert main['scientific_look_delta'] == {'adaptive': 0, 'main': 1}

    forge-input         No-write FORGE_INPUT_RECEIPT; never starts a session

                        write
    disposition-record  Record one authored scientific assessment/withdrawal
                        (ORDINARY_SCIENTIFIC_DISPOSITION_V1). Without
                        --preview it appends to the ResearchStore: run it only
                        inside an authorized scope (see the contract). Advice
                        only: no look, budget, admission or session.
    disposition-show    Read recorded scientific assessments with
                        applicability and lineage; no outcome rows
    discovery-coverage  No-write state-only joint coverage. Never selects
                        typed_value.
    research-scope-resolve
                        Resolve list aliases of a draft query 1.2 to its
                        canonical scope; reads no market value.
    episode-normalized-view
                        Scope-bound NORMALIZED_TRAJECTORY_EPISODES_V1 prefix
                        view for an existing BASE session; reads no target.
    list-snapshot-register
                        Register one local membership snapshot; a manual list
                        is never available before registration.
    discovery-binding   No-write discovery admission binding from the
                        published corpus. Does not read parquet values.
    discovery-execute   Compute one BASE_X price/liquidity query from census
                        and observation rows into an explicit store. Does not
                        select the live store.
    discovery-preview   Feature-only temporal preview. Writes store memory
                        only when --store and --journal-scope are both set.

    persist-draft       Durably bind generated draft bytes to their source

                        read-only counts of HFIC records with placeholder

                        append-only science-memory suppression rebase;

                        read-only HFIC search-memory policy and prior-memory
                        capacity
    memory-policy-preview
                        read-only preview of an append-only HFIC search-memory
                        policy
    memory-policy-apply
                        append-only HFIC search-memory policy; requires
                        --confirm-append-only
    research-policy-status
                        show the active research policy for new runs, and what

    research-policy-preview
                        preview a change of the active defaults for new runs;

                        append one previewed change: either new active

                        read the active Forge research-universe profile from
